jobDescription: Primary Function of Position Intuitive Surgical is widely considered the most exciting medical device company in the world today. Surgeons worldwide are changing the way surgery is performed by utilizing our robotic surgical device, the  da Vinci®  Surgical System, to enhance their surgical precision and greatly improve patient benefits. title: Business Systems Analyst - SAP FICO
Sr SAP Basis System Administrator
jobDescription: Primary Function of Position Seeking a motivated and detail-oriented SAP Basis Senior Consultant to support the management, maintenance, and optimization of SAP landscapes and underlying platform components (S/4HANA, HANA/DB, OS, and interfaces). The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience in SAP BASIS administration with a solid focus on system performance, high availability, reliability, security, and automation. The consultant should be able to support Non-SAP applications including MES, Agile, etc Additionally, the position supports day-to-day operations of SAP and integrated enterprise/manufacturing applications in a production environment, troubleshoots technical issues across the SAP stack, and contributes to continuous improvement initiatives. Exposure to database administration (especially SAP HANA) and infrastructure/cloud operations is considered an added advantage. Essential Job Duties Lead SAP landscape architecture and standards (DEV/QA/PRD, transport routes, maintenance strategy, HA/DR design). Plan and execute SAP installations, system builds, and refreshes (including post-copy hardening and validations). Manage upgrades and lifecycle events (kernel/SAP_BASIS/support packs, SUM/DMO, add-ons, compatibility checks). Execute OS/DB/HANA migrations and major technical cutovers; define rollback and validation plans. Administer core Basis operations: system start/stop, instance/profile parameters, RFCs, background jobs, spool/printing, TMS/STMS, client administration. Monitor and tune performance (workload analysis, dialog/background processing, buffer tuning, DB/HANA performance coordination). Manage HANA operations (backup/restore coordination, performance checks, capacity planning, housekeeping). Own system availability and resilience: backup strategy oversight, DR drills, failover testing, and RTO/RPO alignment. Drive security and compliance: user/admin access governance, patching cadence, audit support, security notes coordination, hardening recommendations. Handle incidents and problem management: root cause analysis, recurring issue elimination, on-call escalation leadership, and postmortems. Integrate and coordinate with OS/DB/network/storage teams; manage dependencies and infrastructure changes. Support SAP interfaces and connectivity (RFC, HTTPS, SAProuter, load balancers, SSO coordination, certificates). Manage SAP application server and web components (ICM, SAP Web Dispatcher where applicable) and connectivity troubleshooting. Maintain and improve monitoring/alerting (Solution Manager/Focused Run/3rd-party tools), dashboards, and runbooks. Automate routine operations (scripting, scheduled checks, parameter baselines, patch automation where feasible). Plan capacity and growth (sizing, forecasting, hardware/cloud scaling recommendations). Own technical documentation: architecture diagrams, SOPs, cutover plans, and operational handover materials. Mentor junior Basis admins and coordinate vendor/partner support; review changes for risk and best practices. Govern change management: transport/import controls, downtime planning, release coordination, and stakeholder communication. Solution Manager setup and configuration Should have worked on ETL tools, BOXI, Tableau, SAP replication tools #LI Hybrid

title: Senior Data Engineer - Supply Chain & Analytics Platforms
jobDescription: Primary Function of Position We are seeking a Senior Data Engineer to design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines, and enterprise data products that support critical supply chain, manufacturing, and operational decision-making processes.  This role will be responsible for developing robust data solutions using modern cloud technologies including Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, Python, and SQL, while ensuring data quality, reliability, and governance across the analytics ecosystem. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in data engineering principles, data modeling, and ELT frameworks, along with experience supporting supply chain and operations analytics.  The successful candidate will partner with business stakeholders, analytics teams, and data scientists to enable trusted, self-service access to data and accelerate insight generation through scalable data products and automation.    Data Engineering & Platform Development  Design, develop, and maintain scalable and reliable data pipelines using Python, SQL, Airflow, dbt, Spark, and cloud-native technologies.  Develop reusable, maintainable, and version-controlled data models that support operational reporting, analytics, and advanced use cases.  Optimize Snowflake data structures, workloads, and SQL performance to improve scalability and cost efficiency.  Implement automated data validation, testing, monitoring, and observability frameworks to ensure high data quality and data reliability.  Develop data products and semantic data layers that enable self-service analytics and standardized business metrics.  Cloud Data Platform & Integration  Design integrations between Snowflake, enterprise applications, APIs, cloud storage platforms, and operational systems.  Build and support data ingestion frameworks utilizing REST APIs, file-based integrations, and event-driven architectures.  Leverage Git-based version control and software engineering practices to improve maintainability and reliability of data assets.  Architecture & Technical Leadership  Provide technical leadership on data modeling, pipeline design, orchestration, and platform scalability.  Establish standards for documentation, testing, monitoring, and operational support.  Mentor junior engineers and promote engineering excellence across the data organization.  Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on platform modernization, automation, and operational efficiency.  Business Partnership & Collaboration  Collaborate with stakeholders across Supply Chain, Service Planning, Manufacturing, Operations, and Analytics organizations to translate business requirements into scalable data solutions.  Partner with Data Science, BI, and Enterprise Analytics teams to deliver trusted and governed datasets.  Support data-driven decision making through development of reliable, high-quality data products and analytical frameworks.    Operational Expectations  Maintain overlapping working hours with EST mornings to support collaboration with global teams and stakeholders.  Participate in production support, root-cause analysis, and incident resolution for critical data pipelines and platforms.  Contribute to on-call support and operational excellence activities as needed.  #LI-Hybrid

title: Director, Finance India
jobDescription: Primary Function of Position: The Director, Finance India leads the India finance organization. This leader is the advisor and business partner for the VP and General Manager of India. Responsible for all finance and sales operations-related matters in the market, including partnering with the Asia finance leadership team to deliver outstanding financial performance, budgeting, forecasting, closing activities, analytics, quotas, reporting, customer targeting, proper financial governance and controllership.  Will be tasked with analyzing complex business problems and providing strategic, data-driven recommendations that support planning, commercial strategy, short and long-range financial models, and accelerated da Vinci adoption in the region. This is a highly analytical role requiring a keen understanding of commercial finance and accounting concepts, analytic processes, the ability to lead and motivate multiple teams, and the ability to communicate and develop meaningful work relationships with multiple executive business partners. Roles and Responsibilities Lead and develop the India finance, accounting, and sales operations teams with specific focus on the organization / team in India. Serve as the primary Finance/Sales Operations strategic advisor for the VP and GM of India. Responsible for all India finance-related and sales operations activity, including: Budgets, forecasts, closing activities, analytics/insight generation, quota development, P&L management, sales commission plans, commercial and financial reporting, customer targeting, financial governance, cash management and accounting. Analyze complex business problems and issues using data from internal and external sources to provide insights, identify patterns, and inform resource allocation decisions to executive leadership. Provide early insights regarding market trends and the resultant strategic/business model impact. Support development of regional goals and provide reporting on progress towards goals. Lead closing activities and ensure US GAAP and statutory reporting requirements are properly met. Work with Corporate tax team and ensure all Tax requirements are met. Work with corporate treasury on cash management. Partner with Executive commercial leadership to develop board-level presentation materials. Use analytical skills to verify or dispel anecdotal insights. Take ownership and lead the financial evaluation for any key important business investments in India.

jobDescription: Primary Function of Position In this role, you will move surgery forward by putting the highest quality and most innovative products in the hands of our customers to enable better surgical outcomes for patients. The ideal candidate must serve as the commodity owner for CNC machining suppliers, with responsibility for developing supplier capability, supporting DFM during product launches, and driving improvements in cost, capacity, quality, and risk management. This role works closely with design engineering, sourcing, manufacturing, and suppliers to ensure manufacturable designs and scalable, capable supplier processes. Supplier Development & Commodity Ownership Own the CNC machining commodity with accountability for supplier capability, performance, and continuous improvement. title: Sr. Manager Trade Compliance
jobDescription: Primary Function of Position The Sr. Manager Trade Compliance is responsible for the trade operations and development of the strategies, policies, processes, and requirements for medical devices import, export, and trade programs. He/ she will ensure regional compliance while managing the expeditions flow of international trade. The responsibility also includes import and export classification, country of origin, trade preferential, supply chain security (C-TPAT, AEO), export control / license determination, and other trade compliance programs. The ideal candidate would be a subject matter expertise of global trade regulations and experience with customs operations with a strong track record of delivering projects that involves coordination across different functions (e.g. tax, supply chain, etc.). Essential Job Duties Develop, implement, and manage the relevant trade compliance policies and procedures manuals and standard work documents necessary to successfully manage import and export operations across the region.  Supervise import/ export transactions, processes and documentation requirements to facilitate the smooth flow of goods across borders while minimizing delays and costs. Oversee daily import / export shipment clearance operations. Lead broker reviews and monitoring to enhance broker performance and cycle times. Manage compliance with preferential-and non-preferential trade, duty suspension, drawback programs and economical customs procedures where applicable. Ensure Regional data integrity related to tariff classification, country of origin, and regulatory information declared to Customs and other Government Agencies. Develop and implement audit programs to ensure the accuracy in the shipping document and customs declaration.  Oversee import and export recordkeeping practices to ensure compliance with Corporate Policy and regulations of all government agencies. Supervise pre- and post-entry audits related to customs declaration, forwarder/ brokers, other logistics service providers and suppliers. Follow up with appropriate corrective action and make corrections when non-compliance is identified. Monitor forwarders and customs brokers and evaluate adherence to Intuitive Brokerage SOP and metrics. Report findings to Corporate Logistics Compliance and follow up with documented corrective action related to monthly brokerage metrics reports. Develop and conduct internal risk assessments. Follow-up with Compliance Improvement Plans. Monitor and report on trade compliance effectiveness, identify gaps, advise on local risk and manage mitigation of these risks. Develop and implement cross-functional training program on import/ export requirements. Audit and maintain data governance in SAP and global product database and applicable trade compliance records in accordance with regulatory requirements. Provide accurate trade data element including product classification, ECCN, country of origin, license determination to internal business units and outside service providers to ensure compliance with Customs regulations and other trade requirements. Serve as a subject matter expert on customs compliance matters, providing guidance and support to internal stakeholders on complex issues and transactions. Participate as core team member on new product development, new market launch, new product launch ensuring that all trade compliance requirements are met. Communicate risks, proposals, regulatory updates and strategies to internal and external stakeholders.  Interact with IT and Center of Excellence (COE) to streamline and improve import/ export data for compliance; communicate requirements to IT and assist with testing and solutions implementation. Conduct and report findings of internal risk assessments. Follow-up with Compliance Improvement Plans. Provide training to other functional groups on trade programs and import and export requirements. Assist in global and/or regional compliance projects/programs. Provide assistance to company sites, suppliers, and customers in the continuous improvement of their compliance functions. Perform other duties, tasks, special projects as assigned.

jobDescription:
Primary Function of Position Business Systems Analyst IT
- ISU will serves as the critical bridge between Information Technology and Internal learning organizations, reporting into the IT Business Applications organization. The primary responsibility of this role is to lead configuration and administration of SAP Success Factors Learning (LMS) and resolve support tickets while ensuring all ISI compliance processes are followed for releases and support. Essential Job Duties 
1. Deep LMS Administration, Configuration & Support (Primary Focus) • Own and support full configuration and administration of SAP Success Factors Learning (LMS). • Manage domains, role based permissions, security structures, assignment profiles, user data imports, and admin roles. • Support business with creation and questions on items, classes, programs, catalogs, curricula, and blended learning structures. • Configure and maintain workflows, approval processes, evaluations, surveys, and notifications. • Manage & provide support on content lifecycle including version control for SCORM/x API/AICC content and troubleshoot tracking issues with precision. • Perform learning history corrections following documented SOPs and governance rules.
2. Compliance, Audit, and Governance  • Maintain audit ready learning records and generate evidence packages as needed. • Implement and enforce governance around user access, data retention, domain structures, and naming conventions. • Partner with Compliance and Internal Audit on quarterly access reviews, history updates, and training completion evidence.
3. Reporting, Analytics & Data Quality • Build accurate and automated reports using Success Factors and work in partnership with Data & Analytics team for tableau reports • Create compliance dashboards for mandatory training, overdue items, curricula completion, and audit metrics with business and Data & Analytics team. • Troubleshoot data inconsistencies, analyze root causes, and ensure history adjustments follow strict controls. • Support data requests from Learning, Leadership, Legal, Security, and Compliance etc.

title: Lead, Public Policy, India
jobDescription: As a member of both Intuitive’s India team and the company’s Global Public Affairs (GPA) organization, you will shape and execute Intuitive’s government affairs strategy and engagement efforts across India. This role is responsible for advancing the company’s policy, regulatory, and stakeholder engagement priorities by building trusted relationships with policymakers, government officials and individuals at both state and central levels, trade associations, chambers of commerce, professional societies, and other influential stakeholder groups across India’s political and healthcare ecosystems. Key Responsibilities Support the Senior Director, Head of Public Affairs, India, in developing, implementing, and executing national, state, and local government affairs strategies that advance Intuitive’s business and policy objectives. Monitor, analyze, and communicate policy, regulatory, and political developments that may impact Intuitive’s business, providing timely insights and recommendations to local and global leadership teams. Develop, cultivate, and maintain strong relationships with policymakers, government officials, trade associations, professional societies, healthcare stakeholders, and other key influencers relevant to Intuitive’s business. Educate external stakeholders on Intuitive’s technology, policy priorities, and contributions to advancing healthcare innovation and patient outcomes. Draft, review, and manage strategic communications and engagement materials, including briefing documents, talking points, policy submissions, position papers, FAQs, and executive correspondence. Build strong partnerships with country leadership, including the General Manager and cross-functional teams such as Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Affairs, Market Access, Medical Affairs, Legal, and Commercial organizations, to ensure alignment on policy priorities and business objectives. Collaborate closely with Public Affairs colleagues across the Asia-Pacific region and globally to advance coordinated advocacy efforts and strengthen Intuitive’s reputation among key stakeholders. Support the development and execution of stakeholder engagement initiatives, policy campaigns, thought leadership programs, and strategic partnerships that further Intuitive’s business and public affairs objectives. Manage and oversee government affairs agencies, consultants, trade associations, and other external partners to ensure effective execution of strategic priorities and measurable outcomes. Represent Intuitive at industry associations, policy forums, government meetings, conferences, and other external engagements, serving as a credible and trusted company representative. Ensure all public affairs activities, communications, and stakeholder engagements are aligned with broader corporate objectives, policy priorities, and compliance requirements. Identify and secure strategic speaking opportunities for the Country General Manager and senior executives at government, healthcare, and industry events to elevate Intuitive’s visibility and thought leadership.

title: Sr. Manager Supplier Engineering
jobDescription: Primary Function of the Position: The successful candidate will lead a team of Supplier Engineers, to develop a portfolio of suppliers that deliver components, parts, and sub-assemblies at lowest landed cost for Intuitive’s robotic systems.  By building technical expertise and business acumen in the Robotics space including its primary commodities of Motion control (electric motors, gearboxes, brakes, sensors, and other actuators), Electronics (PCBAs, PCBs, and electrical harness assemblies), Metals (CNC machining, Castings), and Plastics (injection molding, thermoforming, reaction injection molding), Supplier Engineering leads the technical evaluation during supplier selection, works with suppliers to develop manufacturing processes for components, and qualifies these processes to ensure suppliers can deliver the quality, capability, capacity, and cost necessary to meet Intuitive’s needs. You will be responsible for the engineering relationship with many suppliers and the corresponding spend required to establish production, as well as for the discovery and development of new suppliers. You will strive to deliver the best-in-class performance score from your suppliers which is derived from several KPIs of Capacity, On-time Delivery, Cost reduction, Risk Mitigation, Product Quality and Service levels.   Essential Job Duties: Lead a team of supplier engineers who are delivering value to the business through the following activities. Supply-chain Strategy: Develop and execute Global Supply-chain strategy and roadmap for long term, sustainable and resilient supply-chain to support Intuitive’s Product strategy and roadmap. Supplier Selection: Conduct market research to identify trends in the field of [plastics, Metal] manufacturing and accordingly select and evaluate suppliers to enable Agility and innovation during New Product Introduction, and to enable production scale globally for products that reach broad commercial launch. Establish a strong partnership with the commodity sourcing team to incorporate commercial viability in supplier selection process. Supplier Development and collaboration: Drive and adopt new technologies and automation in supply-chain to achieve high efficiency and production scale. Champion best practices like DFX, Lean, SPC, Six-sigma, Project management, into supply-chain. Establish clear communication channels with suppliers and manage both technical and business relationships Supplier Performance and Monitoring: Partner closely with suppliers to select optimal mfg process and process controls to achieve high quality and cost performance. Develop effective KPIs to monitor supplier performance (delivery, capacity, cost, quality). Execute projects towards continuous improvements of KPIs. Supplier Compliance: Partner with Supplier Quality org to drive audit finding resolution with suppliers through processes like CAPA and SCARs to maintain compliance with QMS requirements Supplier Risk management : Partner with Global supply-chain team to identify various risks within supply-chain and implement mitigation measures. Supplier Change management : For commercially launched products, execute Intuitive’s change management processes like major/moderate change (MCF), Supplier Change Request (SCR) and Change Order (CO) to support large scale projects towards capacity scaling, cost reduction, product quality improvement and supply-chain risk mitigation. Stakeholder Influence : Aligning/Negotiating on project ownership and hand-off points with various peer Supplier engineering groups (like New Product Introduction, Mfg Plant support, Tooling development). Influencing decisions with key partners in Global Ops (planning, sourcing, purchasing), Engineering (Design, Process, Quality) and Project Management Org.

title: Senior Manager - NPI Sourcing
jobDescription: Primary Function of the Position This role is a key leadership position in support of and in the development of Intuitive’s new products, with the strategic and tactical responsibility for the supply chain of the products we develop. Requirements include, providing leadership, program management, strategic sourcing, local and regional sourcing, tactical sourcing and administrative help in the procurement of minimally invasive robotic surgical raw materials and finished products. This key management role will lead the NPI supply chain resources required to help new product introduction (NPI) from initial concept to product release, and stabilization prior to the product transfer to the sustaining purchasing organization. jobDescription: Primary Function of the Position This position is responsible for the development and execution of tactical clinical marketing initiatives to drive da Vinci procedure adoption across prioritized specialties and focus procedures in India. The role partners closely with commercial teams to translate market insights into programs that drive surgeon awareness, d V utilization, and advocacy. The individual will lead market understanding through field immersion, customer insight generation, segmentation, persona development, and value messaging. This role is expected to build scalable clinical marketing programs and assets, collaborate with external surgeons, society leaders, and care teams, and work cross-functionally with sales, training, clinical affairs, market access, legal, regulatory, and compliance to deliver measurable business impact in a fast-paced environment. Guide digital and omnichannel clinical marketing engagement across web, email, social, and field channels for physician, patient, and provider audiences, where applicable. Drive strong cross-functional collaboration and disciplined execution across sales, training, medical, regulatory, legal, and compliance stakeholders.

title: Cardiovascular Program Specialist
jobDescription:
Primary Function of Position The Cardiovascular Program Specialist (CVPS) will provide expert clinical support, education, and training to physicians, nurses, and hospital staff on the use of Da Vinci cardiac surgery, devices and therapies. This role partners closely with the sales team, specifically the Cardiovascular Sales Manager (CVSM) to ensure safe and effective product adoption while driving positive patient outcomes. This role will be a part of a future small team of strategic sales professionals across the country who are focused on developing cardiac surgeons, and all those associated with cardiac programs.    Clinical Support & Case Coverage Provide on-site case support in the operating room or hybrid OR for procedures involving robotic cardiac procedures and surgery technologies. Serve as a clinical expert for product setup, troubleshooting, and optimal use during live cases. Ensure compliance with clinical and safety protocols. Expand the user base collaborating with CVSM to cultivate a training pipeline of new surgeons. Exhibit proficiency in multiple technology platforms to effectively support Da Vinci adoption of Multiport Single Port, digital solutions, and customer needs. Promote advanced instruments and accessories to enhance surgical performance and promote surgeon autonomy. Collaborate with cross-functional internal teams to identify and capitalize on opportunities for expanding the use of the da Vinci® Surgical Systems and strengthening Intuitive’s partnership with healthcare facilities. Training & Education Conduct training for physicians and care team members on indications and proper use of robotic platforms. Administer individualized surgeon and care team training sessions onsite and assist with organizing appropriate mentoring programs. Support new site start-ups by delivering onboarding programs and in-services. Act as a resource for ongoing education and product updates. Design and implement tailored da Vinci® pathways for surgeons and surgical teams to ensure proficient and autonomous system use, by providing recurring care team training as needed. Maintain flexibility to support after-hours cases and provide weekend support as needed, dictated by the territory's adoption of robotic surgery. Collaboration & Sales Partnership Partner with local ISI sales team, leadership, customer training, and business partners to execute the appropriate clinical plan for surgeons and surgical teams to ensure system autonomy within a reasonable time frame Provide clinical insights to the commercial team to shape strategy and drive business growth. Participate in physician education programs, workshops, and regional/national conferences. Facilitate the adoption of our digital solutions through enhancing our customer infrastructure and capabilities. Communicate and collaborate with ancillary equipment manufacturers to develop strategies to ensure overall programmatic success Market & Clinical Insights Collect and communicate customer feedback to internal teams (sales, marketing, R&D). Stay up to date on clinical literature, competitive products, and evolving treatment guidelines. Assist in clinical trial support when required. Preferred Skills and Experience (As applicable
- Specific skills, knowledge, and experience that are not required to perform the job, but are desirable to have) Deep understanding of cardiac anatomy, physiology, and interventional procedures. Exhibit a working knowledge of typical hospital policies. Excellent communication, teaching, and interpersonal skills. Strong problem solving and troubleshooting skills. Ability to work in high-pressure environments (OR/Cath lab) Adaptability to evolving technologies and complex procedures. Team oriented with a commercial mindset. Willingness to travel up to 75% domestically.
